workItem: Create an Owner-activated, time-bound Governance rule that permits one chat to execute a pre-defined roadmap across explicitly scoped project folders while preserving Primary Ownership, per-work-item branches, exact-snapshot PR approval, Human merge, independent assurance and separate protected-mutation gates.
workItemDE: Eine Human-Owner-aktivierte, zeitlich begrenzte Governance-Regel erstellen, die einem Chat die Ausfuehrung einer vorab definierten Roadmap ueber explizit freigegebene Projektordner hinweg erlaubt, ohne Primary Ownership, Work-Item-Branches, exakte PR-Snapshot-Freigaben, Human Merge, unabhaengige Assurance oder separate Protected-Mutation-Gates aufzuheben.
ownerRole: Repository Governance and Platform Director authority design only; this candidate does not itself activate cross-project execution or grant provider IAM/production authority before Human Merge.
correlationInputs: no open pull requests against main
agent/governance-post-merge-cleanup-20260901 exists without changed-file overlap; it must re-correlate if this authority change merges first
nonGoals: Create or assign a real provider Global Administrator/IAM role
Pre-authorize unknown future PR head SHAs
Authorize Human Merge, deployment or production mutation
Allow Security self-verification, Accepted Risk self-approval or legal/compliance self-classification
Bundle multiple Primary Owners into one branch or Pull Request
authorityGuard: The new rule is a bounded JIT execution delegation, not an ownership transfer. Activation must be explicit, roadmap/document/project/work-item scoped, time-limited and auditable. Every target work item retains its target-project branch slug, work claim and owner boundaries. Exact-snapshot PR creation approval, Human/CODEOWNER merge and separate protected external-mutation approvals remain mandatory. The rule is not effective until Human Merge of its governance PR.
releaseCondition: Release on Human merge, close, supersession or abandonment. PR creation for this governance candidate remains exact Base/Head snapshot Human/Owner-gated; merge remains Human/CODEOWNER-only.
